8256.title: Native menu activation during layout switching
8256.rootCauseOneLine: Non-Mac windows enable an Alt-activatable native menu; whether Windows layout switching triggers focus loss remains unverified.
8256.proposedFix: Capture Windows layout-switch, menu, and focus events before choosing a narrowly scoped desktop input fix.
8256.caveats: Two clean Linux checkouts repeated only a production-resolver diagnostic; no Windows native reproduction, screenshot, or failing focus regression test. Existing focused tests: 77 passed in each checkout. Diagnostic source and results are inline; raw artifacts remain local per the reports repository policy.
